rule: Claim id = <source>-<edition>-<nnn>. First assignment: nnn is the 1-based position of the row in data/raw/<source>/<edition>.json `entries`, zero-padded to 3 digits, counting rows that are not claims (gaps allowed); edition-level quotes outside `entries` follow the last entry. envisioning-technology keeps its raw ids (et-2012-045 -> envisioning-technology-2012-045). After the first assignment this registry governs: a known key keeps its id forever; a new key gets the next number above `last` in its edition. Ids are never reused.
